# FreeTV Garden

> Browser-based directory of free live TV channel streams from around the world. No signup, no app, and no subscription required.

## About

FreeTV Garden lets visitors watch live television and radio channels from 200+ countries directly in a web browser, using an interactive globe interface to browse by country. The service links to and embeds publicly available broadcast streams; it does not host or store video content itself.

## Key Facts

- 1,000+ live TV channels across 200+ countries
- No account, signup, or app download required
- Works in any modern browser on desktop, mobile, and smart TV
- Categories include news, sports, music, and entertainment

## Primary Page

- [FreeTV Garden](https://freetvgarden.com/): Homepage and full channel directory
